Portals 1.1.10 packages the portal transfer loop fix in a new versioned wheel.

- Players are moved to safe ground outside all nearby portal frames before a server transfer is scheduled.
- The delayed transfer verifies the player's position again; failed moves, re-entry and disconnects cancel it.
- Join and teleport arrivals must exit their destination portal before another activation.
- Pending transfers cannot survive a quit/rejoin or plugin shutdown.

No additional gameplay changes since 1.1.9. All 18 portal regression tests run before publishing.

Install the new wheel in plugins/, remove the previous Portals wheel and restart Endstone.
